tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Checks whether a website is technically open to AI assistants: robots.txt rules for 9 AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot), presence of llms.txt, and on the home page the title, meta description and JSON-LD
